text:
Short versions you can paste directly:

- 幂等 → **idempotent** (adj.) / **idempotency** (noun). e.g. *"This endpoint is idempotent: repeating the same request has no additional effect."* / *"Retries are safe because the operation guarantees idempotency."*
- 最终一致性 → **eventual consistency** (noun) / **eventually consistent** (adj.). e.g. *"Replicas are eventually consistent: reads may briefly return stale data, but all nodes converge."* Note: it's a weak consistency model, not "final" consistency.
- 背压 → **backpressure** (one word is the common spelling in tech docs; *back pressure* also appears). e.g. *"The consumer applies backpressure when it cannot keep up with the producer."*

Two common pitfalls worth avoiding:
- Don't write "power-equivalent" or "idempotence" as a verb form — use `is idempotent` / `idempotency`.
- Don't translate 最终一致性 as "final consistency"; readers will read it as "the last consistency," not the CAP sense.

If you need a one-line glossary entry style:

```
Idempotency: safely retrying the same request produces the same result.
Eventual consistency: replicas converge to the same state, but not immediately.
Backpressure: a consumer signals the producer to slow down when it is overloaded.
```
